analysis_contract.scope: Q1-A existing artifacts only, remote CPU, no remote file writes
analysis_contract.equality: all six float32 parameters bitwise per true T-to-S edge; any mismatch stops equal-start analysis
analysis_contract.death: first recorded alpha <= 0.005 at after_Adam_before_strategy; initial not-alive is time 0, separately reported
analysis_contract.primary_population: families with source and every paired target alive immediately after relocation; equality and initial-mask agreement required
analysis_contract.family_effect: D_S - mean_j D_Tj; equal mean across families within each case and owner
analysis_contract.target_distribution: cumulative first-death counts j=0..k per family, retaining all-survive/all-die/mixed and individual target first-death histograms
analysis_contract.timing: compare S to every individual T with weight 1/k within family; both-censored distinct from same observed death time
analysis_contract.earliest_target: supplementary only; affected by k, not individual-risk evidence
analysis_contract.strata: exact k for multiplicity diagnostics, no causal adjustment; broader Q1-B/C/D not executed
analysis_contract.inference: descriptive only, no p-values, confidence intervals, independent-Gaussian assumption, or Adam causal claim

results.individual_outcome_storage: Immutable original target/source mapping plus all 100 per-step masks remain the per-slot source of truth; each target death is computed separately before aggregation, no binary family target collapse.
